claims.claim: Jonas ran the technical validation demo with Petra Novak (champion) and Milan Horak (technical evaluator).
claims.why: CRM roles and the call lines show these three people at the demo.

claims.claim: The demo used line 3 sensor data that Milan supplied.
claims.why: Jonas says the line 3 readings are the ones Milan sent.

claims.claim: About 2,000 readings per second from line 3 landed in under 10 seconds.
claims.why: Matches Jonas's figures.

claims.claim: Milan said line 3 has old controllers and that if it works there, it works everywhere.
claims.why: Direct paraphrase of Milan's line.

claims.claim: The downtime dashboard classifies stoppages by cause and shows minutes lost per shift.
claims.why: Stated by Jonas.

claims.claim: Petra said plant managers get this only in a weekly spreadsheet today and expects them to like the dashboard.
claims.why: Petra said they will love it and get a weekly spreadsheet today.

claims.claim: The quality model flags batches whose sensor patterns resemble past defects.
claims.why: Jonas's description.

claims.claim: The quality model was trained on 18 months of defect records, about 900 defect batches, which Milan called most of their history.
claims.why: Matches Jonas's and Milan's lines.

claims.claim: Petra called the demo really strong and proposed a pilot on line 3.
claims.why: Both quoted lines are from Petra.

claims.claim: Petra said legal will not accept a processor storing data outside the EU.
claims.why: Stated directly by Petra.

claims.claim: Petra said the CFO froze new software spend until Q2, so a contract before April is unlikely.
claims.why: Petra's words: second quarter, contract before April unlikely.

claims.claim: Petra's legal team wants the EU hosting confirmation in writing.
claims.why: Petra said they will want it in writing.

claims.claim: Jonas said the tenant can be pinned to Frankfurt including backups, and he would confirm contract wording with compliance.
claims.why: Direct paraphrase of Jonas.

claims.claim: A budget exception may exist if the product replaces something already paid for; Petra is unsure it does.
claims.why: Petra said maybe and that she is not sure; output also marks it unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Milan asked how much history the quality model learned from.
claims.why: Milan asked how many past defects it learned from.

claims.claim: Milan suggested the product might replace the old historian license, which renews in March.
claims.why: Milan said it might replace the historian license renewing in March.

claims.claim: The call did not cover how the quality model performs on unseen batches or how it connects to other lines.
claims.why: Nothing in the transcript discusses either topic; supported by absence.

claims.claim: The CRM close date is 2026-12-18, which conflicts with Petra's statement that a contract before April is unlikely.
claims.why: CRM close_date is 2026-12-18; Petra said before April is unlikely.

claims.claim: The historian replacement was raised only as a maybe and Petra has to check with finance.
claims.why: Petra said maybe and that she would have to check with finance.

claims.claim: The CRM economic buyer field is blank and the decision process was never discussed.
claims.why: CRM shows economic_buyer empty and decision_process Not discussed.

claims.claim: The CFO controls the budget decision, and neither the CFO nor legal was on the call.
claims.why: CFO froze spend and legal sets hosting rules; only Petra and Milan attended.

claims.claim: EU residency is unresolved: Jonas's answer was conditional on compliance, with no owner or date for written confirmation.
claims.why: Jonas deferred contract wording to compliance; no owner or date set.

claims.claim: Petra raised both blockers late in the call as she was wrapping up.
claims.why: Raised after the wrap-up prompt, shortly before she left.

claims.claim: The transcript shows no accuracy or false-positive figures for the quality model.
claims.why: No such figures appear in the transcript.

claims.claim: Milan's works-everywhere remark is his inference, not something demonstrated.
claims.why: Only line 3 was shown.

claims.claim: CRM dated next step reads Pilot on line 3 with no date; business outcome was prefilled and unedited; stakeholder-to-add is empty.
claims.why: All match CRM close_the_demo fields.

claims.claim: The call was logged as running exactly its 10-minute slot.
claims.why: CRM actual_end equals scheduled_end at 09:10.

claims.claim: Jonas will send the pilot plan with success criteria by Monday, October 5, 2026.
claims.why: Jonas stated this commitment and date.

claims.claim: Milan will arrange controller access for line 3 by Friday, October 9, 2026.
claims.why: Milan committed to controller access by Friday, October 9th.

claims.claim: Petra will check with finance whether the product could replace the historian license; no date given.
claims.why: Petra said she would have to check; the output marks it not firm.

claims.claim: Apex has an unassigned item to get written EU hosting confirmation via compliance, with no date.
claims.why: Jonas said he would confirm with compliance; Petra wants it in writing; no owner or date.

claims.claim: The close date should be re-forecast to likely 2027 Q2 unless the exception is confirmed.
claims.why: Follows from the freeze until Q2 and the unconfirmed exception; hedged with likely.

claims.claim: The email says Apex will have compliance confirm the exact wording and send it to Petra by a date to be confirmed.
claims.why: Jonas said he'd confirm wording; sending it to Petra was not promised; date is a placeholder.

claims.claim: The email says Apex can pin Petra's tenant to Frankfurt, including backups.
claims.why: Matches Jonas's statement and RC-14.

claims.why: Petra said the pilot is fine.
